verdict_reason: The row-based seedLine and clearing of stored search rows are correct, but the add-a-collection recipe still shows the old keys-based call and the no-common-name branch is untested.

todos.issue: commitSelection now takes chosen search rows (rows.map(seedLine)) instead of keys, and this PR edits add-a-collection.md, yet the recipe's batch-split snippet (add-a-collection.md:257) still shows 'selected.map(seedLine)' and says the reconcile lives in search.controller.js, where it no longer is (it is in actions/commit-selection.js).
todos.fix: Must: the add-a-collection.md batch-split section shows the reconcile as it is now: seedLine mapped over the chosen search rows, in actions/commit-selection.js. One way: change the snippet to 'rows.map(seedLine)', point the link at actions/commit-selection.js, and say each row carries commodityCode, speciesLatinName and commonName from the shown search results.

todos.issue: seedLine leaves commonName off the line when the row has none ('...(commonName ? { commonName } : {})'), the case MDM's missing common names produce, but every row in search/test-support.js has a commonName and the controller tests compare with toEqual (which treats an undefined key as absent), so deleting the conditional or always writing commonName keeps every test green.
todos.fix: Must: a test fails if a chosen row with no common name saves a line carrying a commonName key (undefined, null or empty). One way: add a search.controller.test.js case that commits a stored row without commonName and asserts Object.keys(line) (or toStrictEqual) on the saved line; or drop the conditional and always copy commonName if the persistence layer is shown not to care.
